++// DEVELOPERS PLEASE NOTE
++//
++// All language files should use UTF-8 as their encoding and the files must not contain a BOM.
++//
++// Placeholders can now contain order information, e.g. instead of
++// 'Page %s of %s' you can (and should) write 'Page %1$s of %2$s', this allows
++// translators to re-order the output of data while ensuring it remains correct
++//
++// You do not need this where single placeholders are used, e.g. 'Message %d' is fine
++// equally where a string contains only two placeholders which are used to wrap text
++// in a url you again do not need to specify an order e.g., 'Click %sHERE%s' is fine

++// DEVELOPERS PLEASE NOTE
++//
++// All language files should use UTF-8 as their encoding and the files must not contain a BOM.
++//
++// Placeholders can now contain order information, e.g. instead of
++// 'Page %s of %s' you can (and should) write 'Page %1$s of %2$s', this allows
++// translators to re-order the output of data while ensuring it remains correct
++//
++// You do not need this where single placeholders are used, e.g. 'Message %d' is fine
++// equally where a string contains only two placeholders which are used to wrap text
++// in a url you again do not need to specify an order e.g., 'Click %sHERE%s' is fine

+++// All language files should use UTF-8 as their encoding and the files must not contain a BOM.
+++//
+++// Placeholders can now contain order information, e.g. instead of
+++// 'Page %s of %s' you can (and should) write 'Page %1$s of %2$s', this allows
+++// translators to re-order the output of data while ensuring it remains correct
+++//
+++// You do not need this where single placeholders are used, e.g. 'Message %d' is fine
+++// equally where a string contains only two placeholders which are used to wrap text
+++// in a url you again do not need to specify an order e.g., 'Click %sHERE%s' is fine

+++// All language files should use UTF-8 as their encoding and the files must not contain a BOM.
+++//
+++// Placeholders can now contain order information, e.g. instead of
+++// 'Page %s of %s' you can (and should) write 'Page %1$s of %2$s', this allows
+++// translators to re-order the output of data while ensuring it remains correct
+++//
+++// You do not need this where single placeholders are used, e.g. 'Message %d' is fine
+++// equally where a string contains only two placeholders which are used to wrap text
+++// in a url you again do not need to specify an order e.g., 'Click %sHERE%s' is fine

+<?php
+/**
+*
+* BBPoints extension for the phpBB Forum Software package.

+* @license Proprietary

+{
+	exit;
+}
+
+if (empty($lang) || !is_array($lang))
+{
+	$lang = array();
+}
+
+// DEVELOPERS PLEASE NOTE
+//
+// All language files should use UTF-8 as their encoding and the files must not contain a BOM.
+//
+// Placeholders can now contain order information, e.g. instead of
+// 'Page %s of %s' you can (and should) write 'Page %1$s of %2$s', this allows
+// translators to re-order the output of data while ensuring it remains correct
+//
+// You do not need this where single placeholders are used, e.g. 'Message %d' is fine
+// equally where a string contains only two placeholders which are used to wrap text
+// in a url you again do not need to specify an order e.g., 'Click %sHERE%s' is fine
+//
+// Some characters you may want to copy&paste:
+// ’ » “ ” …
+//
+
+$lang = array_merge($lang, array(
+	'ACL_F_HIDE_TOPIC'		    => 'Pode ocultar (e colocar preço) do próprio tópico',
+	'ACL_U_BBPOINTS_OVERRIDE'	=> 'Pode subscrever limite de PontosGold',
+));

+{
+	$lang = array();
+}
+
+// DEVELOPERS PLEASE NOTE
+//
+// All language files should use UTF-8 as their encoding and the files must not contain a BOM.
+//
+// Placeholders can now contain order information, e.g. instead of
+// 'Page %s of %s' you can (and should) write 'Page %1$s of %2$s', this allows
+// translators to re-order the output of data while ensuring it remains correct
+//
+// You do not need this where single placeholders are used, e.g. 'Message %d' is fine
+// equally where a string contains only two placeholders which are used to wrap text
+// in a url you again do not need to specify an order e.g., 'Click %sHERE%s' is fine
+//
+// Some characters you may want to copy&paste:
+// ’ » “ ” …
+//
+
+$lang = array_merge($lang, array(

diff --git "[FORUM_EXT]/sitesplat\\bbpoints/styles/BBOOTS/template/js/bbpoints.min.js" "[FORUM_EXT]/sitesplat\\bbpoints/styles/BBOOTS/template/js/bbpoints.min.js"
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ "[FORUM_EXT]/sitesplat\\bbpoints/styles/BBOOTS/template/js/bbpoints.min.js"
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+head.ready(function () {
+function enterUserLang() { 
+	return enter_user_lang;
+};
+; (function ($, window, document) {
+
+    $('#sendclick').click(function(event) {
+		event.preventDefault();
+		if ($('#transfer_to').val() > 0 && parseInt($('#amount').val()) > 4 && parseInt($('#amount').val()) <= parseInt(userpoints))
+		{
+			amount = parseInt(userpoints) - parseInt($('#amount').val());
+			$('#userbbpoint').text(amount.toFixed(2));
+		}
+    });
+
+	$('#transfer_to').autocomplete({
+		source: function(request, response) {
+					$.ajax({
+						type: "POST",
+						url: boardurl + 'bbpoints/search_user',
+						dataType: "json",
+						data: {
+							term: request.term
+						},
+						error: function(xhr, textStatus, errorThrown) {
+							alert('Error: ' + xhr.responseText);
+						},
+						success: function(data) {
+							response($.map(data, function(c) {

diff --git "[FORUM_EXT]/sitesplat\\bbpoints/styles/BBOOTS/template/js/modal_bbpoints.min.js" "[FORUM_EXT]/sitesplat\\bbpoints/styles/BBOOTS/template/js/modal_bbpoints.min.js"

+head.ready(function () {
+	function enterUserLang() { 
+		return "Enter user...";
+	};
+
+; (function ($, window, document) {
+
+    $('#sendclick').click(function(event) {
+		event.preventDefault();
+		if ($('#mtransfer_to').val() > 0 && parseInt($('#amount').val()) > 4 && parseInt($('#amount').val()) <= parseInt(userpoints))
+		{
+			amount = parseInt(userpoints) - parseInt($('#amount').val());
+			$('#userbbpoint').text(amount.toFixed(2));
+		}
+    });
+
+	$('#mtransfer_to').autocomplete({
+		source: function(request, response) {
+					$.ajax({
+						type: "POST",
+						url: boardurl + 'bbpoints/search_user',
+						dataType: "json",
+						data: {
+							term: request.term
+						},
+						error: function(xhr, textStatus, errorThrown) {
+							alert('Error: ' + xhr.responseText);
+						},
+						success: function(data) {
+							response($.map(data, function(c) {
+								return {
+									value: c.value,
+									label: c.label,
+								};
+							}));
+						}
+					});
+				},
+		select: function(event, ui) { 
+			event.preventDefault(); 
+			$(this).val(ui.item.label); 
+			$("#mtransfer_id_to").val(ui.item.value); 
+		},
+		placeholder: enterUserLang,
+		minLength: 2
+	});
+	
+})(jQuery, window, document);
+});
